posts.body:
Seats are filling fast!

Catch SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY from the comfort of our premium recliner seats while enjoying delicious food, handcrafted drinks, and the ultimate movie experience.

🎟️ Book your seats now at AlamoIndy.com

Experience Christopher Nolan's THE ODYSSEY, featuring breathtaking visuals and an incredible cast led by Matt Damon, at Alamo Drafthouse Indianapolis.

Enjoy blockbuster entertainment with delicious food, craft drinks, and our signature dine-in movie experience.

Book your tickets today at AlamoIndy.com

🌊 Have you booked your tickets yet?

Disney's Moana (2026) is setting sail! Join Moana and Maui on an unforgettable adventure beyond the reef in this stunning live-action reimagining of the beloved classic.

🎟️ Book your tickets today at AlamoIndy.com

🎬 EVIL DEAD BURN

🔥 The Deadites are back! Be among the first to experience Sam Raimi's EVIL DEAD BURN at our Advance Screening, presented by Fantastic Fest.

🍸 Enjoy themed bites, specialty cocktails, and take home a commemorative EVIL DEAD BURN air freshener.

🎟️ Book your tickets today: alamoindy.com

📍 Alamo Drafthouse Indianapolis

Tonight at Alamo Indy: blame Canada, blame the MPAA, blame your parents, but absolutely do not blame us.

SOUTH PARK: BIGGER, LONGER & UNCUT screens tonight at 7 PM — the 1999 animated musical so filthy the MPAA tried to slap it with an NC-17, so Trey Parker and Matt Stone did the only reasonable thing:

They made the songs worse.

They won.

Twenty-seven years later, it’s still one of the funniest movies ever made about censorship, moral panic, war movies, bad parenting, and the very American tradition of losing our minds over what children are “allowed” to see.

Tonight only. 7 PM.
Tickets at alamoindy.com.

There's no crying in movie trivia. There is silent team disappointment. Movie Trivia starts at 6 PM in the Hot Rod Bar. Eight rounds of original film questions. Teams welcome. Solo players welcome. People who yell "I knew that!" after the answer is revealed also, technically, welcome. Win passes. Earn bragging rights. Ruin one friendship over a visual round. See you tonight at 6 PM | Alamo Drafthouse Indianapolis | Hot Rod Bar.

Cancel your summer plans because Kids Camp is back and we've packed the season with discounted tickets, family favorites, Kids Passports, and giant first-run adventures like TOY STORY 5, MINIONS & MONSTERS, MOANA, and PAW PATROL: THE DINO MOVIE.

Add in make-in-your-seat crafts, giveaways, themed menus, free gifts with kids' meals, and enough monster slime and squishy bananas to keep everyone happy, and you've got your summer plans covered.

Category is: Essential Cinema.

PARIS IS BURNING screens today at Alamo Indy at 4 PM — Jennie Livingston’s landmark documentary on the Harlem ball scene, chosen family, performance, survival, and the culture that reshaped culture.

Released in 1990. Still quoted. Still debated. Still devastating. Still required viewing.

Today only. 4 PM.

Sunday at Alamo Indy: PARIS IS BURNING at 4 PM.

The ballroom. The houses. The categories. The looks. The language. The legacy.

Jennie Livingston’s landmark 1990 documentary captures the Harlem ball scene with beauty, humor, intimacy, and tension — and 36 years later, it still hits with the force of a film that never stopped being relevant.

Sunday. 4 PM. Big screen.

Tickets at alamoindy.com.

Friday night at Alamo Indy: emotional whiplash, served correctly.

At 7 PM, we’ve got the BUT I’M A CHEERLEADER Movie Party — a candy-colored queer cult classic about conversion therapy, rebellion, and falling for exactly the girl you were not supposed to fall for.

At 9:45 PM, we’ve got CANNIBAL HOLOCAUST — the notorious 1980 Italian found-footage nightmare so convincing its director had to prove in court that his actors were, in fact, alive.

Same night. Same building. Two very different definitions of “cult classic.”

Tickets at alamoindy.com.
